name: B10-0158/2025 (PfE) – Continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text:
This resolution does not change any law. It states the opinion of a group of Members of the European Parliament. They condemn Russia's war on Ukraine and say that after three years, the European Union should rethink its approach. They call for a peace settlement that keeps Ukraine and the European Union secure in the long term. They also say defence decisions should stay with each member country, and that any defence action should aim to prevent hostility, not increase it.

- No law changes; this is an opinion that calls for a new European Union strategy for peace.
- It affects member countries' defence choices and future talks on Ukraine.
- Next, the text is sent to the Council, the Commission, member countries, Ukraine, the United Nations, Russia and the United States.
